scenario_A.name: Environment + System (without Cultivar)
scenario_A.description: Model menggunakan 11 fitur biofisik lingkungan statis dan cuaca pra-tanam 60 hari ditambah klasifikasi sistem budidaya (System), tanpa informasi kultivar.

scenario_B.name: Environment + System + Cultivar
scenario_B.description: Model menggunakan 11 fitur biofisik lingkungan dan System seperti pada Skenario A, ditambah fitur Cultivar yang diproses dengan penanganan missing (UNKNOWN), rare (<5 train fold) ke RARE_OR_UNSEEN, dan unseen test ke RARE_OR_UNSEEN.

cultivar_rules.rare_policy: Categories with count < 5 in training fold are mapped to 'RARE_OR_UNSEEN'
cultivar_rules.unseen_test_policy: Categories in test set not in training fold frequent categories (>=5) are mapped to 'RARE_OR_UNSEEN'
cultivar_rules.leakage_prevention: Thresholding and vocabulary strictly fitted on training fold data only.
